title: Hikaru no Go: Hokuto Hai e no Michi

synonyms: Hikaru no Go: Journey to the North Star Cup
alternative_titles.ja: ヒカルの碁 北斗杯への道

synopsis:
Hikaru is given a phone call asking him to appear in the Japan/China/Korea Junior's Tournament but he finds out he will have to take place in a preliminary tournament to choose Japan's three contestants. Upon discussing this with Akira, he discovers that Akira has already been chosen for the tournament and will not be taking place in the preliminaries. Hikaru then decides not to visit Akira's Go Salon until he takes his place on the team with Akira. That may be tougher than originally planned, as not only does Hikaru have to battle with old friends for one of two coveted spots, but he may have a new challenger, in a promising player from the Kansai Go Institute. 

(Source: ANN)

episodes_data.title: Eternal Rivals
episodes_data.description: Twelve-year old Hikaru Shindo finds a old Go board with an hidden surprise. Trapped inside is Fujiwara-no-Sai, the ghost of a ancient Go master…

episodes_data.title: The Key Point
episodes_data.description: After defeating Go prodigy Akira Toya with the help of Sai, Hikaru starts to get a better understanding of the game through classes with a local Go tutor…

episodes_data.title: Akira Bares His Fangs
episodes_data.description: Going on instinct, Akira finds Hikaru at Children’s Go Tournament and demands to know about more about this Go-playing upstart…

episodes_data.title: Kaga of the Shogi Club
episodes_data.description: Initially rebuffing Akari’s invitation to the Haze Junior High festival, Hikaru decides to attend only to be stood up. As he walks through the festival grounds, he spots a Go demonstration, much to the delight of Sai.

episodes_data.title: An Inkling of an Awakening
episodes_data.description: In a game of Go that could go either way, Kaga defeats Hikaru. But instead of making him jump into a freezing cold pool, Kaga recruits Hikaru to join he and Kimihiro to play in an upcoming Go tournament at rival Kaio Middle…

episodes_data.title: A Game of Beauty
episodes_data.description: As if the pressure of getting caught for playing in the Go tournament, Akira Toya is touring the grounds of Kaio Middle, a school with a powerful Go team…

episodes_data.title: I'm Not Going to Play You!
episodes_data.description: With the Go Tournament behind them, Hikaru is now an official student at Haze Middle school and is eager to start a Go team with Kimihiro. It’s just too bad that Kaga has quit to rejoin the Shogi Club…

episodes_data.title: Rainy Day Strategy
episodes_data.description: Akira Toya’s presence on the Kaio Go Club has made him the most hated member of the team. Not only is he a Go master in the making, but he beats everyone who dares to face him…

episodes_data.title: Eyesore
episodes_data.description: As the newest member of the Kaio Go Club, Akira must clean an old classroom to be used by the Girls’ Go Team. But as soon as he starts to clean and look through old books of Go Strategy, Kojima and Ito, two Kaio teammates, trick him into playing Go without looking at the board. ..

episodes_data.title: The Third Player
episodes_data.description: Still looking for that elusive third player, Akari tells Hikaru and Kimihiro about Yuki Mitani, a fellow classmate who can play a mean game of go. The only problem is that he wants nothing to do with amateur tournaments…

episodes_data.title: A Very Despicable Act
episodes_data.description: Hikaru discovers Yuki secret to winning at Go…Cheating! When Hikaru returns to the Go Salon, it appears that the Shu, the Go Salon keeper, has brought in a ringer to stop Yuki and his hustling...

episodes_data.title: No Cheating Allowed
episodes_data.description: In a token of thanks for defeating the ringer at the Go Salon, Yuki joins the Go Club and gives his word not to cheat. Over at Kaio Middle, Akira plots his next move in trying to face Hikaru once again...

episodes_data.title: A Personal Resolve
episodes_data.description: Now that Haze Middle can “officially” enter school tournaments, Hikaru, Yuki and Kimihiro are ready to win it all…

episodes_data.title: The Third Match
episodes_data.description: It’s Kaio Middle School versus Haze Middle School. Yuki faces off against Kaio’s captain, the arrogant Kishimoto while Hikaru takes on Akira for the third time…

episodes_data.title: The Ghost in the Net
episodes_data.description: With summertime around the corner, Hikaru and Akira find themselves traveling new paths on their journeys. Akira gives up the Kaio Go Club and decides to take the Pro Exam while Hikaru introduced to the world of Internet Go…

episodes_data.title: Who Is Sai?
episodes_data.description: Between Hikaru’s novice computer skills and Sai’s strength at playing Go, they become the most unbeatable player in the world of Internet Go…

episodes_data.title: The Match of Revelation
episodes_data.description: At the World Amateur Championship, the air is abuzz with interest in Sai whom some of the participants have played online at one time or another…

episodes_data.title: Akira vs. Sai
episodes_data.description: Eager to take on Sai, Akira doesn’t even bother to show up for his first pro exam match. But Sai defeats him, leaving Akira to wonder if it’s Hikaru on the other side of the board…

episodes_data.title: Hikaru's True Strength
episodes_data.description: Summer’s winding down and thanks to all his internet playing with Sai, his game has gotten stronger…

episodes_data.title: The Road to Turning Pro
episodes_data.description: After a chance meeting in a bookstore, Kishimoto, the captain of the Kaio Go Club, takes Hikaru to a Go Salon to see what kind of player he truly is...

episodes_data.title: The Haze Middle School Go Club
episodes_data.description: Hikaru returns to the Go club to announce his intentions on becoming an Insei, which angers Yuki Mitani and disappoints the rest of the Haze Middle Go Club…

episodes_data.title: The Insei Test
episodes_data.description: Even with his new-found love for the game of Go, Hikaru finds it nearly impossible to sit comfortably, let alone beat his opponent during the test…

episodes_data.title: The Championship Room
episodes_data.description: Now that he’s an insei, Hikaru’s finding that winning is hard to come by. Starting off with six straight losses, Hikaru’s at the bottom of the B-league with little hope in sight…

episodes_data.title: Akira vs. the Oza
episodes_data.description: As the Shinshodan Series starts up, the Oza is taken aback by Akira’s seemingly easy rise to the pros. Instead of playing a simple exhibition match against the young prodigy, he’s going to challenge Akira with everything he’s got…

episodes_data.title: Fear and Impatience
episodes_data.description: Waya invites Hikaru to a study session with his teacher, Morishita-sensei. Hikaru learns about the Young Lions Tournament, where only the top 16 Insei in the A-league get to compete against newly crowned pros…

episodes_data.title: Welcome to the A-League!
episodes_data.description: It hasn’t been easy, but Hikaru’s moved up the ranks and out of the B-league. Now he’s taking on a tougher group of opponents, including the mistake-prone Fuku, Waya’s toughest opponent.

episodes_data.title: A Place to Return
episodes_data.description: Feeling a bit nostalgic, Hikaru comes back to visit to Haze Middle Go Club, where things have gone from bad to worse. Since Yuki quit, the club cannot participate in school tournaments…

episodes_data.title: The Young Lions Tournament
episodes_data.description: It’s time for the Young Lions Tournament, where 16 newly crowned pros take on the Top 16 Insei in the A-League…

episodes_data.title: Kuwabara Hon'inbo
episodes_data.description: As the Young Lions Tournament winds down, Hikaru loses his match to Murakami 2 –Dan. Anxious to know about how the entire match progressed, Akira presses Ogata Sensei, one of the spectators at the tournament, for answers…

episodes_data.title: Ogata vs. the Hon'inbo
episodes_data.description: In the lobby of the Go Association building, Kadowaki, a top College player, is looking to brush up on his game before taking the Pro Exam. Enter Hikaru, who with Sai’s help, teaches this amateur how the game of Go is truly played…

episodes_data.title: The Awful Opponent
episodes_data.description: The Prelims for the Pro Exams are about to start! Hikaru starts off on an unlucky streak when he draws Tsubaki, a loud and overbearing biker who uses his time to think about his moves…on the back of his motorcycle…

episodes_data.title: The Last Day of the Prelims
episodes_data.description: After losing two games in a row, Hikaru’s self-confidence is shaken…

episodes_data.title: We're a Team!
episodes_data.description: In the hopes of helping Hikaru get over his fear of playing adults, Waya and Isumi take him to a Go Salon to take on opponents of a more mature nature…

episodes_data.title: No Winning Allowed!
episodes_data.description: At a local festival Akira is asked to play 4 players simultaneously including Kurimoto, a boorish and rude city councilman. To make matter worse, he’s been asked by the festival organizers to let Kurimoto win…

episodes_data.title: Only One Can Win
episodes_data.description: On the recommendation of a fellow Go player, Hikaru, Waya and Isumi try out a new Go Salon that’s different from the rest…

episodes_data.title: My Name Is...
episodes_data.description: After a contemptuous and intense battle, Hikaru triumphs over Su-yong, leaving his Korean opponent more determined than ever to take on Hikaru once again…

episodes_data.title: The Pro Exam Begins
episodes_data.description: It’s time for the Pro Exam and Hikaru’s starting off with six straight wins in a row. Can he keep his winning streak going or will his fellow insei knock him off his undefeated pedestal...?

episodes_data.title: The Challengers
episodes_data.description: As the Pro Exam continues, Hikaru learns from his fellow opponents that the road to turning pro isn’t as easy as it appears to be.

episodes_data.title: An Ill-Fated Moment
episodes_data.description: Ready to take on an undefeated Isumi, Hikaru knows he’s in for a tough match…

episodes_data.title: Where Are the Victories?
episodes_data.description: With the pressure mounting, Isumi makes a wrong move forcing him to resign and forfeit the match…

episodes_data.title: Three Weeks Isn't Enough!
episodes_data.description: Determined to get his game back on track, Isumi takes on Ochi with a vengeance. But Ochi is more concerned with his final opponent: Hikaru.

episodes_data.title: The First to Pass
episodes_data.description: Now that the Pro Exam is winding down, the stronger players are beginning to distinguish themselves from the weaker ones…

episodes_data.title: Hikaru vs. Waya
episodes_data.description: Now that Ochi has passed the Pro Exam, there are only two spots remaining. With only two games left in the exam, Hikaru faces off against Waya…

episodes_data.title: Comeback from the Brink
episodes_data.description: As Hikaru takes on Waya to advance towards the pros, Waya notices that his opponent’s game bears a interesting resemblance to Sai…

episodes_data.title: Hikaru vs. Ochi
episodes_data.description: Gearing up for the match, Ochi reveals to Hikaru that he has been studying with Akira Toya in the hopes of learning how to beat him in the pro exam…

episodes_data.title: The Final Day of the Pro Exam
episodes_data.description: It’s down to the wire as to who will make it into the world of the pros. Will Hikaru upset Ochi, the newly crowned pro, or will Isumi sneak by with his four losses...?

episodes_data.title: Into the World of the Pros
episodes_data.description: Now that Hikaru’s gone pro, he can’t wait to play all the top pros, including Akira Toya and his father, Toya Meijin…

episodes_data.title: Sai vs. Meijin
episodes_data.description: The ever-busy Toya Meijin has finally decided to participate in the Shinshodan Series on one condition: his opponent must be Hikaru Shindo…

episodes_data.title: A Game of Desperate Measures
episodes_data.description: From newly-turned pros Ochi and Waya to Go-playing veterans Ogata and Kuwabaru Hon’inbo, everyone’s got their eye on this match between Hikaru and Toya Meijin…

episodes_data.title: Fujiwara-no-Sai
episodes_data.description: In order to better understand why the spirits of Go have kept his soul on the planet, Sai reflects upon his life during the Heian Period as well as when he met Hikaru and faced Akira Toya.

episodes_data.title: Kurata 6-Dan
episodes_data.description: Feeling the need to cheer up a depressed Sai, Hikaru takes him to an Amateur Go Festival, where they expose a local merchant selling counterfeit Go merchandise and meet Atsushi Kurata, a friendly, but overconfident pro who delights at giving by signing fans for his most devoted fans...

episodes_data.title: Hikaru vs. Akira
episodes_data.description: All dressed up to receive his 1-dan certificate, Hikaru learns about the Oteai, a series of games that determine a player’s ranking as well as who his first opponent will be…

episodes_data.title: The Acknowledgement of Sai
episodes_data.description: Toya Meijin falls victim to a heart attack and is rushed to the hospital. Hikaru goes to visit him and discovers that he’s supplementing his recuperation by playing Go on the internet…

episodes_data.title: The Excited Mounts
episodes_data.description: Now that Toya Meijin is playing Internet Go, the world is abuzz with excitements, watching a professional champion play online…

episodes_data.title: Sai vs. Koyo Toya
episodes_data.description: The wait is over! Sai and Toya Meijin face off in a match that has the entire world glued to their computer screens. Who will triumph and discover the Divine Move?

episodes_data.title: After a Millennium Comes the Answer
episodes_data.description: With the Sai finally facing Toya Meijin, the entire world of Go sit on the edge of their seat. Who will triumph in this battle of epic proportions?

episodes_data.title: Let Me Play Sai!
episodes_data.description: Now that the match has ended, Hikaru tries to talk Toya Meijin out of his fateful decision…

episodes_data.title: One-Color Go
episodes_data.description: After running into Kurata 6-Dan at Ramen Shop, Hikaru challenges him to game of Go…

episodes_data.title: Koyo Toya Retires!
episodes_data.description: Fulfilling his promise to Hikaru, Koyo Toya resigns from playing Go professionally, sending shockwaves throughout the world.

episodes_data.title: Farewell Hikaru
episodes_data.description: Hikaru gets invited to a Go seminar and gets an unavoidable request from Ogata to play Sai, who senses that his time with Hikaru is rapidly coming to an end.

episodes_data.title: Is Sai Really Gone?
episodes_data.description: The time has come for Sai to leave has come, leaving Hikaru angry and frustrated.

episodes_data.title: Hiroshima's Strongest Player
episodes_data.description: While in Innoshima, Mr. Kawai stumbles into a Go Salon where, as a result of a misunderstanding, he finds himself owing a lot of money to Shuhei, a formidable Go player who is enormous both in size and talent.

episodes_data.title: I Won't Ever Play Again!
episodes_data.description: Hikaru goes through old game records to find past matches with the great Hon’inbo Shusaku…

episodes_data.title: Keichou Flower Bowls
episodes_data.description: In this bonus flashback episode, Hikaru and Sai encounter an antiques dealer who sells counterfeit heirlooms he claims are from the distant past…

episodes_data.title: Isumi no Go
episodes_data.description: In order to rediscover his game, Isumi goes to China where he meets a young, impulsive player who bares a striking resemblance to a friend and fellow former insei.

episodes_data.title: Fateful Encounter
episodes_data.description: Back before Hikaru Shindo met Akira Toya, a young Children’s Go champion pays Akira a visit to the Go Salon in order to challenge him.

episodes_data.title: Isumi's Test
episodes_data.description: Still in China, Isumi decides to stay and to improve his game and boost his confidence. With the help of his new friend Yang Hai, he challenges the bratty Le Ping to a rematch…

episodes_data.title: Losing by Default
episodes_data.description: With Hikaru giving up on Go, everyone is worried, including his mother, who vents her concerns to his teacher.

episodes_data.title: A Determined Visitor
episodes_data.description: Isumi returns to Japan a stronger and more focused player. He soons discovers what everyone else already knows: Hikaru Shindo is losing his games by default…

episodes_data.title: Sai Was Here...
episodes_data.description: Isumi finally tracks down Hikaru and pleads with him to play one game with him. Hikaru, fearful that if he plays Sai will not return, reluctantly agrees…

episodes_data.title: Making a Comeback
episodes_data.description: Hikaru’s back to his old self and ready to move up the rankings of professional Go. First up is Murakami, a pro who previously defeated Hikaru in the Young Lions Tournament.

episodes_data.title: The Race Is On
episodes_data.description: Now that Hikaru’s playing again, he’s drawn the attention of Go Players throughout Tokyo, as well as the readers and writers of Go Weekly.

episodes_data.title: Shindo vs. Toya
episodes_data.description: The match-ups for the Meijin Qualifiers is out and it’s Hikaru vs. Akira in the first round.

episodes_data.title: The Power Within
episodes_data.description: The match everyone has been waiting for has finally begun! With every move, the game builds with a fevered intensity.

episodes_data.title: A Nostalgic Smile
episodes_data.description: As they break for lunch, Akira confronts Hikaru on the fact that he has discovered that Sai is within him. After the game, Hikaru goes home and goes to sleep…
